module.pfp.name: TSQ Profile Picture
module.pfp.description: Shows a member's profile picture or profile banner large: /pfp [uye] [tur], /banner [uye] [tur].
cmd.pfp: Show a member's profile picture large
cmd.banner: Show a member's profile banner large
pfp.default_note: This user has no profile picture of their own; Discord's default profile picture is shown.
pfp.missing.server_avatar: Discord reported no server-specific profile picture for this member. Choose the type ‘Genel’ for the global one.
pfp.missing.server_banner: Discord reported no server-specific profile banner for this member. Choose the type ‘Genel’ for the global one.
pfp.missing.global_banner: Discord reported no banner on this user's global profile.
pfp.missing.any_banner: Discord reported no banner for this user, neither on the global profile nor on this server's profile.
pfp.note.server_avatar_not_reported: Discord reported no server-specific profile picture; the global profile picture is shown.
pfp.note.server_banner_not_reported: Discord reported no server-specific profile banner; the global banner is shown.
pfp.not_member: This person is not a member of this server (they may have left), so their profile picture cannot be shown.
pfp.unavailable: The profile could not be read right now. Try again in a moment.
pfp.cooldown: Wait a moment: you can try again in {0} seconds.
pfp.invalid_scope: Invalid type. Choose Otomatik, Genel or Sunucu.
